$source_revision._note: 0.2.0 schema bump: every entry now carries value_class. All FLAG quantities are theoretical_lattice_qcd (lattice-QCD calculations) — never safe for model verification.

m_pi_charged.description: Charged pion mass (FLAG-tabulated, but FLAG defers to PDG experimental value)
m_pi_charged._note: FLAG quotes the PDG-experimental pion mass as a fundamental input. Underlying source is PDG; reproduced here for namespace completeness.

f_K_over_f_pi.description: Ratio of kaon to pion decay constants

g_A.description: Nucleon axial-vector charge from lattice QCD
g_A._note: FLAG 2024 N_f=2+1+1 lattice value. Experimental value from neutron beta decay is g_A=1.2754(13).

sigma_piN.description: Pion-nucleon sigma term (light-quark contribution to nucleon mass)
sigma_piN._note: FLAG 2024 N_f=2+1+1 lattice value. Disagrees with phenomenological extraction (~59 MeV).
